rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a person's unhappiness or discontent.

example.english: I have dissatisfaction with this arrangement.
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 go3 on1 paai4 jau5 bat1 mun5

rows.note: Use this for the particular thing or aspect that causes the dissatisfaction, rather than the feeling itself.

example.english: Tell me which parts of the plan are causing your dissatisfaction.
example.traditional: 你講下你對個計劃有咩不滿嘅地方。
example.jyutping: nei5 gong2 haa5 nei5 deoi3 go3 gai3 waak6 jau5 me1 bat1 mun5 ge3 dei6 fong1
